name: nullable-left-cycle
grammar: grammar Invalid { @package: org.example.uniquelongest @root @mapping(Root) @uniqueLongestChoice Root ::= ['x'] A | 'x'; A ::= [B]; B ::= [A]; }

name: cxx23-direct-additive-left-recursion
grammar: grammar Cxx23DirectAdditive { @package: org.example.uniquelongest token NUMBER=org.unlaxer.parser.elementary.NumberParser @root @mapping(Root) @uniqueLongestChoice Root ::= Root '-' NUMBER | NUMBER; }
